label: SDIC3 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses an SDIC3 Serratia defense-island candidate locus that can confer strong protection against several bacteriophages when plasmid expressed.
observations: Phage-defense branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual SDIC3A, SDIC3B, SDIC3C, SDIC3D, SDIC3E, and SDIC3F genes and proteins, the SDIC3B-F HMM profile rows, source database rows naming one SDIC3 model, Serratia defense islands, the ECOR61 prophage-encoded anti-phage system, the absent DefenseFinder rule-level model, unresolved direct effector chemistry, and other SDIC or phage-defense systems.
